subject: Compute v2 currently leaves SHADER_PROGRAM and LOCAL_STORAGE zero
body: One independent active-job blocker beyond the obsolete resource ABI: dispatch_v2 zeroes mem and points chain.shader tocmd+128/thread_storage tocmd+192, but NEVER calls nord2_desc_shader_program or nord2_desc_local_storage. The only such calls in the file remain in v1 dispatch at551/554. Thus a v2 submit currently references an all-zero shader descriptor despite retaining code BO. Preserve v1-style codeVA/preload/register allocation/local-storage setup in v2 before submit, with exact package facts. Also wire push_words must equal the validated package requirement (or use package value directly), not choose an arbitrary smallerFAUcount; current only checks<=128. Tests must decode the COMPLETE resulting COMPUTE_JOB + SHADER_PROGRAM + LOCAL_STORAGE + SRT and prove the selected code address/registers/preload/local groups, not just a successful fake submit. Runtime edge regions must validate selected package local size against each region specialization, not always originalrequested local, or nonuniform dispatchThreads tails will refuse. No audit build.
